title: office.scribe-pending request
description: Parse one session transcript through the conversation adapter (text between the user and the agent only, credentials scrubbed) into .orbit/tmp/scribe/<session_id>.jsonl, owner-only, and return what the scribe has not read yet. Model-free; no Library write.

transcript.description: Transcript path inside the granted workspace or Library.

provider.description: Transcript format; only claude-code has an adapter.

cwd.description: The session's working directory; its last component is the project name and the default topic.
